statement: Improve the bound Var(log Z_n) = O(n/log n) for directed polymers in random environment in general dimension to a power improvement n^{1-eps}.
status_search: In d = 1+1 with exactly solvable weights (log-gamma, exponential last-passage) the exponent 2/3 (variance n^{2/3}) is a theorem; for general weights in any dimension the BKS-type n/log n remains the best general bound to this session's knowledge; cf. the FPP variance problem in the Codex campaign (P-a/ chi = 1/3 target).
title: Fluctuation exponent of directed polymers beyond the logarithmic improvement
